plan.purpose: Extend CPU shadow repetition evidence into unfinished paragraphs; audit normal stopped outputs and opportunities for the proposed positive-coefficient gate. No intervention is executed.
plan.input: Original unsteered 1.5B 500 MATH training calibration answers. Reuse saved generated token IDs and log probabilities; retain all 16000-token caps. Not MATH-500 evaluation or the 40 counterfactual continuations.

rule.atoms: Incrementally decode complete UTF-8 characters. A word starts with a Unicode letter or underscore and continues through letters, digits or underscores. A number is a maximal digit sequence, also retaining dots/commas when followed by another digit. All other non-whitespace characters are individual symbol atoms. Ignore whitespace only; preserve case, every digit and every symbol. Publish words/numbers only after an observed following character establishes their end. A pending numeric dot/comma needs one-character lookahead. Never flush pending atoms or UTF-8 bytes at EOF or </think>.
rule.candidate: After each complete atom, find the shortest positive period whose two adjacent copies form the current suffix and contain at least two distinct atoms. Repeating one atom alone is deliberately excluded (e.g. identical digits or a word alone); those forms remain a known limitation. No minimum character/token length or tuned persistence threshold. Two copies supply a repetition witness, not a safe action criterion.
rule.episode: While later complete atoms follow the candidate period, extend its episode. On mismatch, close it at that observed token and search the current suffix. Initial event fields are immutable; episode duration/copy count is retrospective. A hash only accelerates search; always verify matching atoms exactly.
rule.inputs: Only arrived generated bytes and positions feed the detector. No confidence, finish status, question gold or future text. Stop before the </think> token; no final-answer matching.
rule.comparison: Read the frozen earlier paragraph-monitor summary without rerunning or changing that detector. Report new atom-channel and earlier paragraph-channel outcomes separately, plus their union as a coverage statistic only. Do not claim an online combined policy was tested.

projection.purpose: Measure whether an active atom episode coincides with an actual original boundary and a positive coefficient. This is an opportunity count on unsteered prefixes, not measured gate benefit.
projection.timing: After a generated token arrives, feed all its bytes to the monitor. If its ID is an original paragraph-boundary token and the current step has probabilities, compute the original coefficient using step arithmetic mean and adjacent-step population variance. Check detector active state at the end of this token. A gate could affect the following forward pass at this boundary; it cannot create a new injection position.
projection.numeric: Use the existing verified CPU scalar projection of the frozen function, float64. Use 1e-6 only as a numeric near-zero reporting tolerance. No CUDA equivalence or actual dynamic trajectory is claimed.
projection.candidate_action_not_executed: At eligible positive boundaries the proposed rule would replace alpha by min(alpha,0), while preserving the original controller state and later updates. This replay only counts such opportunities.

review.new_stopped_sample: Fix a random sample of 12 naturally stopped answers newly alerted by the atom channel (or all if fewer). Inspect their question, complete reasoning prefix through first alert, two repeat copies, following 1200 characters and final 1000 characters. Review the longest episode separately; clearly disclose if the intervening answer was not fully read.
review.known_stopped: Review the earlier 3 stopped-alarm counterexamples 274,348,469 separately; they are not new validation.
review.old_misses: Review all 15 earlier unalerted caps. Show first and longest atom episode, whether an episode occurs inside the previously unfinished tail, and bounded context. Scope is repetition evidence, not a full correctness audit.
review.labels: One Codex reviewer; no independent semantic gold. Normal stop and cap are outcome categories, not ground-truth normal/overthinking labels. Report ambiguity and legitimate calculation/formula restatement, not a manufactured precision score.

plan.development_exposure: The earlier 30, boundary-study 20 and other 450 remain separate. All 500 are calibration/development data, not independent validation. This rule is informed by the earlier 15 missed cases; recovery is a development check, not generalization evidence.

manifest.generation: vLLM greedy, raw selected-token log probabilities

limitations: Outcome cross-tabs are not semantic precision/recall.
The rule uses prior failure review; all500 are development data, not independent validation.
Ignoring whitespace and comparing complete atoms admits legitimate short restatements and calculations.
No persistence threshold or action trigger has been validated. Single-atom repetition is intentionally not captured.
Later episode growth and remaining observed tokens are not evidence available at the first alert, nor actual saved tokens.
Positive opportunities are float64 projections on unsteered prefixes; runtime overhead and causal gate benefit remain unmeasured.
